speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon
text: asked	the Prime Minister what are the cybersecurity measures being taken to ensure the integrity of our banking system and financial transactions in light of the recent cyber theft incident encountered by Bangladesh Bank.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Prime Minister)
text: This means having in place measures to protect their critical systems, to detect threats and system vulnerabilities in a timely manner and also to recover from cyberattacks swiftly.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Prime Minister)
text: They must conduct regular security reviews and tests to ascertain the continued effectiveness of these measures.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Prime Minister)
text: And where there are any gaps or areas of improvement identified, MAS requires the FI to develop a remedial plan of action and will monitor the institution's progress in its implementation.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Prime Minister)
text: MAS also monitors the prevailing cyber threat landscape and issues targeted advisories to FIs.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Prime Minister)
text: The FIs themselves have been taking proactive steps to combat cybersecurity risks.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Prime Minister)
text: In addition to investments at the individual FI level, they are also collaborating on industry initiatives to strengthen the sector's cyber resilience.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Prime Minister)
text: Since its inception, the SCCS has championed a number of initiatives to raise industry standards, for example, in the area of penetration testing.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Prime Minister)
text: They have also commenced regular sector-level cyber exercises amongst its members to test the FIs' responses and operating procedures against various cyber threat scenarios.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Prime Minister)
text: The group also meets regularly to exchange insights and intelligence on cyber threats.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Prime Minister)
text: So, MAS will continue to work with our FIs and industry partners to monitor developments in cyberspace and to adapt defences, as appropriate, to stay cyber-resilient.

speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
text: I would also like to ask him whether there are any plans to develop a local talent pool for the cybersecurity industry in order to broaden the talent and expertise to deal with such threats.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Can I ask if MAS has performed audits or reviews on the effectiveness of IT controls very specific to FAST, which stands for Fast and Secure Transfers?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: If not, is there a plan to do so?
